newsitem.title: USA: Fed's 10-day fixed system RPs total $5.059 billion.
newsitem.headline: Fed's 10-day fixed system RPs total $5.059 billion.

text.p: The Federal Reserve's addition of reserves via 10-day fixed-system repurchase agreements totaled $5.059 billion on Monday, a Fed spokeswoman said.

Detailing the size of its system repurchase agreements operation is part of the Fed's new daily open market operations announced late last year. The Fed revamped its daily intervention procedure to keep pace with stepped-up market activity.
At 1123 EST/1623 GMT, the overnight bank lending, or federal funds rate, stood at the Fed's 5-1/4-percent target rate.
